feed.title: epic-jam-2026 / devlog
feed.subtitle: A participant's devlog for the Epic AI MegaJam 2026

entry.title: day-1.log: build the smallest world
entry.summary: At 06:00 there was no game. Eighteen hours later there was a tested UE 5.8 build ladder, an island, NPCs, time and weather, five parallel creative tracks, and a very honest list of what was still broken.

entry.title: push_pull.md: inspiration, not a plan
entry.summary: There is no concept yet. There is a pile of directions pulling against each other, and me being overwhelmed at 3 AM, three hours before the start.

entry.title: validate.sh: the night before, and a Director's Cut
entry.summary: One long day of testing everything twice, an agent that went one step too far, deleting it all, the kickoff stream and the theme.

entry.title: boot.log: a kidnapped workstation
entry.summary: How a work PC got kidnapped twice before reaching the office, why I'm doing this at all, and the toolchain I set up in the two weeks before the jam.
